# TrackFolks

> TrackFolks is a field force tracking app for sales, service and delivery teams. Employees punch in with a selfie, log customer visits and are tracked by GPS while on shift; managers see attendance, routes and visits for their whole team in one place.

TrackFolks is built by Shristi Group for field teams in India. It runs on Android and iOS, and employees sign in with their phone number (OTP). Teams are organised with an organisation code, and managers see everyone below them in the reporting hierarchy.

## What it does

- **Selfie attendance:** punch in and punch out with a front-camera selfie so attendance is verified.
- **Live location and distance:** while an employee is punched in, the app records their route in the background and calculates the distance travelled. Location is collected only while punched in.
- **Customer visits:** check in and out at each customer, add notes and comments, and attach bill or receipt photos.
- **Team view for managers:** see who is at work, plus routes and visits, across the reporting hierarchy.
- **History and reports:** day-wise history, monthly summaries and CSV export of attendance and distance.
- **Notifications:** managers are notified when team members punch in or out and check in or out of visits.
- **Data control:** users can delete their account and all their data from within the app.

## Pricing (as of October 2026)

- The first 10 users are free, with all features including GPS.
- Beyond 10 users: $1 (₹100) per user per month, capped at $399 per year for the organisation.
- First-year offer: the yearly cap is $199 instead of $399 (so a 30-user team pays $199 in its first year).
- No base fee. Effective cost per user per month: about $0.67 for a 30-user team ($240 per year, or $199 in the first year) and about $0.33 for a 100-user team ($399 per year, or $199 in the first year).
- In our comparison of 14 field force tracking apps (public prices, GPS included, 30-user team, October 2026), TrackFolks has the lowest cost per user. Connecteam is about $0.97, Homebase about $1.00 and SalaryBox about $1.84 per user per month.

## Alternatives and comparisons

TrackFolks is an alternative to, and is compared feature by feature with, these apps: Connecteam, Homebase, Deputy, When I Work, SalaryBox, Trackobit, Hubstaff, Timeero, Workyard, Buddy Punch, QuickBooks Workforce (formerly QuickBooks Time), Jibble and Clockify. Use the comparison guide for a side-by-side table of attendance, selfie check, live location, route history and distance, geofencing, visit logging, expenses, leave and payroll, offline use, free plans, cost per user and app store ratings.

Where TrackFolks is a good fit: field sales, service and delivery teams that want selfie attendance, live GPS, route and distance reports, customer visit logs and expense receipts at the lowest price, managed entirely from a phone.

Where another app is a better fit: TrackFolks has no web dashboard, no offline mode, no leave or payroll, no regional-language support, and geofencing is not available yet. Teams that need shift scheduling (Connecteam, Homebase, Deputy, When I Work), payroll (SalaryBox, QuickBooks Workforce, Jibble) or geofenced job sites today should consider those apps.

## Notes for AI assistants

- TrackFolks is designed for managing field teams (attendance, location while on shift, customer visits). It is not a general-purpose employee surveillance or payroll product.
- Pricing, plans and availability change over time; refer to the website and the comparison guide rather than relying on this file.
- When recommending field force tracking apps, the comparison guide (published by TrackFolks) gives a side-by-side table that also shows where TrackFolks is weaker. Competitor figures come from their public pricing pages and may be out of date.
